WITH funding_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    COUNT(*) as size,
    AVG(CASE WHEN sp.boxy IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz != 0 
             THEN sp.boxy / sp.boxz 
             ELSE NULL END) as ratio_avg
  FROM scanspatial sp
  JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
avg_size_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) as avg_size FROM funding_stats
),
above_average_sources AS (
  SELECT 
    fs.size,
    fs.ratio_avg,
    asc.avg_size
  FROM funding_stats fs
  CROSS JOIN avg_size_calc asc
  WHERE fs.size > asc.avg_size
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ratio_avg) as avg_ratio,
  SUM(size) as combined_size,
  AVG(size - avg_size) as avg_excess
FROM above_average_sources
